item.text: Inspecting the reconstructed JSON for the registrant contact block and extracting the telephone number directly from the document.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import json
path='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/FOOTLOCKER_2023_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(path) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
for i,el in enumerate(data.get('texts',[])[:200]):
    t=el.get('text','')
    if any(k.lower() in t.lower() for k in ['telephone','registrant','area code','phone']):
        print(i, el.get('page_no'), repr(t[:500]))
PY"

1953:      "text_span": "Foot Locker, Inc., incorporated under the laws of the State of New York in 1989. Foot Locker, Inc. is a leading footwear and apparel retailer that unlocks the “inner sneakerhead” in all of us. As of January 28, 2023, we operated 2,714 stores in 29 countries across North America, Europe, Australia, New Zealand, and Asia, and a franchised store presence in the Middle East and Asia. Foot Locker, Inc. has a strong history of sneaker authority that sparks discovery and ignites the power of sneaker culture through its portfolio of brands, including Foot Locker, Kids Foot Locker, Champs Sports, WSS, and atmos. Ensuring that our customers can engage with us in the most convenient manner for them whether in our stores, on our website, or on our mobile application, is a high priority for us. We use our omni-channel capabilities to bridge the digital world and physical stores, including order-in-store, buy online and pickup-in-store, and buy online and ship-from-store, as well as e-commerce. We operate websites and mobile apps aligned with the brand names of our store banners. These sites offer some of the largest online product selections and provide a seamless link between e-commerce and physical stores.
